milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the acacia wood cluster at spawn-relative (7, 2, 5) and face it, confirming they have visually located it. Target is the middle of the acacia wood trunk. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the dark oak pressure plate at spawn-relative (-5, 0, -3) which marks the workshop entrance, and face it. max_distance=16 allows detection from viewing distance, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the pressure plate.

Uses inventory_has to check for iron_ingot because the meaningful result of interacting with the blast furnace is smelting iron ore into iron ingots. The player starts with iron_ore and coal but no iron_ingots, so having at least 1 iron_ingot in inventory proves they successfully used the blast furnace to smelt. This is more reliable than position-based checks since it verifies actual functional interaction.

Uses inventory_has because crafting iron_boots results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts without iron_boots, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting at the crafting table using the iron ingots obtained from the blast furnace.
